verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents string labels that can be attached to messages and threads, allow/block lists, and multiple inboxes. These are building blocks or adjacent features. There is no evidence of the product itself splitting incoming mail into categorized streams such as important, team, newsletters, or calendar invites, or of ordering triage by priority.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
